requirements.text: A new bookmark shall be added into a specific location within the bookmarks hierarchy.
Bookmarks shall be properly deleted from bookmarks file and no longer be displayed  from all access points.
Bookmarks shall be added and deleted from the personal toolbar.
New bookmark folder shall be inserted into the bookmarks hierarchy.
Double-clicking on a bookmark shall cause it to be launched in a browser window.
Bookmarks within the default bookmarks file that is packaged with the browser shall be valid links.
Changes to a bookmark item shall be saved without loss of item integrity.
Bookmarks separators shall be added and deleted.
Bookmarks changes shall be saved over restart/crash.
View properties shall execute for bookmarks, folders, and separators(negative).
Bookmarks shall be renamed "inline", i.e. without having to use the bookmarks properties dialog.
Bookmarks shall be found using user-defined custom keyword.
Bookmarks shall be sorted and reverse-sorted per column.
Bookmark columns shall be resizable to show/hide more of entries.
Bookmark columns shall be showed and hidden.
Several bookmarks shall be deleted at one time.
It shall be not possible to drop a bookmark item onto itself or its immediate parent or child.

generated_cases.title: Add bookmark to specific location (Normal)
generated_cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark can be successfully added to a specific valid location within the bookmarks hierarchy.

generated_cases.title: Add bookmark at hierarchy boundaries (Boundary)
generated_cases.description: Verify adding a bookmark at the root level versus a deeply nested location within the bookmarks hierarchy.

generated_cases.title: Add bookmark to non-existent location (Error)
generated_cases.description: Verify that attempting to add a new bookmark to a non-existent location within the bookmarks hierarchy fails appropriately.

generated_cases.title: Normal Deletion of Bookmark
generated_cases.description: Verify that a bookmark is properly deleted from the bookmarks file and is no longer displayed from all access points.

generated_cases.title: Edge Case Deletion of Non-Existent Bookmark
generated_cases.description: Verify the system behavior when attempting to delete a bookmark that has already been deleted or does not exist.

generated_cases.title: Abnormal Deletion with File Permission Error
generated_cases.description: Verify that an appropriate error is handled when a file permission error occurs during the bookmark deletion process.

generated_cases.title: Add and Delete Bookmark from Personal Toolbar - Normal
generated_cases.description: Verify that a bookmark can be successfully added to the personal toolbar and subsequently deleted from it.

generated_cases.title: Personal Toolbar Capacity Limit - Boundary
generated_cases.description: Verify the behavior when adding bookmarks to the personal toolbar up to its maximum capacity limit.

generated_cases.title: Insert new bookmark folder into hierarchy
generated_cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark folder can be successfully inserted into a specific valid location within the bookmarks hierarchy.

generated_cases.title: Insert bookmark folder at maximum allowed hierarchy depth
generated_cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark folder can be inserted at the maximum supported nesting depth of the bookmarks hierarchy.

generated_cases.title: Insert bookmark folder with invalid name
generated_cases.description: Verify that attempting to insert a new bookmark folder with an invalid or prohibited name format is appropriately handled and rejected.

generated_cases.title: Double-click bookmark normal launch
generated_cases.description: Verify that double-clicking on a valid bookmark successfully launches the associated URL in a new or current browser window.

generated_cases.title: Double-click bookmark with corrupted or invalid URL
generated_cases.description: Verify the application behavior when double-clicking on a bookmark containing a corrupted or invalid URL, ensuring appropriate error handling.

generated_cases.title: Validate links in default bookmarks file
generated_cases.description: Verify that bookmarks within the default bookmarks file that is packaged with the browser are valid links under normal operating conditions.

generated_cases.title: Abnormal handling of broken links in packaged file
generated_cases.description: Verify the system behavior when encountering broken or malformed links within the default bookmarks file packaged with the browser.

generated_cases.title: Normal Change Save Integrity
generated_cases.description: Verify that changes made to a bookmark item are successfully saved without loss of item integrity.

generated_cases.title: Abnormal Data Corruption on Save
generated_cases.description: Verify the system handles data corruption or write failures gracefully when attempting to save changes to a bookmark item.

generated_cases.title: Normal Deletion of Bookmarks Folder
generated_cases.description: Verify that an existing bookmarks folder can be successfully deleted from the bookmarks hierarchy.

generated_cases.title: Edge Case Deletion of Empty versus Non-Empty Folder
generated_cases.description: Verify the deletion behavior when deleting an empty bookmarks folder compared to deleting a non-empty bookmarks folder containing subfolders and items.

generated_cases.title: Add and Delete Bookmarks Separators Normal
generated_cases.description: Verify that bookmarks separators can be successfully added to and deleted from the bookmarks hierarchy.

generated_cases.title: Invalid Separator Placement Abnormal
generated_cases.description: Verify the system handles invalid separator placement attempts, such as placing separators in restricted system containers, gracefully.

generated_cases.title: Save Bookmark Changes Over Normal Restart
generated_cases.description: Verify that all changes made to bookmarks are successfully saved and persisted after a normal application restart.

generated_cases.title: Save Bookmark Changes Over Browser Crash
generated_cases.description: Verify that all changes made to bookmarks are successfully preserved and not lost when the browser experiences an unexpected crash.

generated_cases.title: View properties negative test for bookmarks, folders, and separators
generated_cases.description: Verify that view properties execute correctly for bookmarks, folders, and separators as a negative test per requirement R-011.

generated_cases.title: Accessing restricted properties for bookmarks, folders, and separators
generated_cases.description: Verify the abnormal scenario where attempting to access restricted or invalid properties for bookmarks, folders, and separators is handled appropriately.

generated_cases.title: Normal - Inline Bookmark Rename
generated_cases.description: Verify that a bookmark can be renamed inline directly in the UI without opening the bookmarks properties dialog.

generated_cases.title: Edge - Rename with Special Characters or Empty String
generated_cases.description: Verify inline renaming behavior when entering edge-case inputs such as special characters, emojis, or attempting to clear the name completely.

generated_cases.title: Find Bookmark Using Valid Custom Keyword - Normal
generated_cases.description: Verify that a user can successfully find and access a bookmark by entering its assigned custom keyword in the address bar or search.

generated_cases.title: Find Bookmark With Duplicate Keywords - Edge
generated_cases.description: Verify the system behavior when multiple bookmarks are assigned the same custom keyword (edge scenario).

generated_cases.title: Search With Non-Existent Custom Keyword - Edge
generated_cases.description: Verify that searching for a custom keyword that does not exist returns no bookmarks or an appropriate not-found indication.

generated_cases.title: Sort and Reverse-Sort Bookmark Columns (Normal)
generated_cases.description: Verify that bookmarks can be successfully sorted and reverse-sorted per column in ascending and descending order.

generated_cases.title: Sort Columns with Empty or Special Characters (Edge)
generated_cases.description: Verify sorting and reverse-sorting behavior on columns containing empty entries or special characters.

generated_cases.title: Normal Column Resizing
generated_cases.description: Resize bookmark columns to show and hide more of the entries successfully.

generated_cases.title: Boundary Column Widths
generated_cases.description: Resize bookmark columns to their minimum and maximum possible width boundaries.

generated_cases.title: Show and Hide Bookmark Columns Normal Operation
generated_cases.description: Verify that bookmark columns can be successfully shown and hidden using the column configuration interface.

generated_cases.title: Hide All Bookmark Columns Boundary Condition
generated_cases.description: Verify the system behavior when attempting to hide all available bookmark columns to ensure edge case compliance.

generated_cases.title: Bulk Delete Several Bookmarks Normal
generated_cases.description: Verify that multiple selected bookmarks are successfully deleted at one time from the bookmarks list.

generated_cases.title: Bulk Delete Zero Bookmarks Edge
generated_cases.description: Verify the system behavior when a bulk delete action is triggered with zero bookmarks selected.

generated_cases.title: Drop bookmark onto itself
generated_cases.description: Verify that it is not possible to drop a bookmark item onto itself within the bookmarks hierarchy.

generated_cases.title: Drop bookmark onto its immediate parent
generated_cases.description: Verify that it is not possible to drop a bookmark item onto its immediate parent folder.

generated_cases.title: Drop bookmark onto its immediate child
generated_cases.description: Verify that it is not possible to drop a bookmark folder onto its immediate child item.

reference_cases.description:
INITIAL CONDITIONS

3. You also have the option to use this very large bookmarks file.

reference_cases.title: TC-014
reference_cases.description:
INITIAL CONDITIONS
1. Install this bookmarks file.(abcdbookmarks.html)
2. You must also customize your sidebar to include a bookmarks panel.

STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Select Bookmarks|Manage Bookmarks.
2. Click on the "Name" column once.
3. Click on the "Name" column a second time.
4. Click on the "Name" column a third time.
5. Click on the "URL" column once, and a second time.
6. Click on the "Custom Keyword" column once, and a second time.
7. Click on the "Description" column once, and a second time.
8. Click on the "Last Visit" column once, and a second time.
9. Click on the "Added On" column once, and a second time.
10. Click on the "Last Modified" column once, and a second time.

EXPECTED RESULTSBy step
1. The bookmarks should sort into alphabetical order. (a-b-c-d-e)
2. The bookmarks should sort into reverse-alphabetical order. (e-d-c-b-a)
3. The bookmarks should sort into "natural" order (the way they were originally sorted). (a-d-e-b-c)
4. The bookmarks should sort into order by URL and then the reverse of that order. (d-a-b-c-e)
5. The bookmarks should sort into order by Custom Keyword and then the reverse of that order. (c-d-a-b-e)
6. The bookmarks should sort into order by Description and then the reverse of that order. (b-c-d-a-e)
7. The bookmarks should sort into order by Last Visited time and then the reverse of that order.
8. The bookmarks should sort into order by Added On date and then the reverse of that order.
9. The bookmarks should sort into order by Last Modified date and then the reverse of that order.
10. Separators should separate the sort as well, ie step one should result in a-b-c-d-e|aa-bb-cc-dd-ee, not a-aa-b-bb-c-cc-d-dd-e|.

LINKS
1. netscape-bookmarks.html
2. mozilla-bookmarks.html
3. large-bookmarks.html

INITIAL CONDITIONS
